content: Routing of SecuredIPdu s SecuredIPdu s shall have a PduTriggering and IPduPort defined since they are handled by the PduR. Pdu s that are part of a SecuredIPdu and are also handled by the Com module shall have a PduTriggering and IPduPort s since they are handled by the PduR (and Com).
